name: airy-adventure
label: Воздушная сказка
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an EDITED DESIGN PROPOSAL based on attached reference 1, removing visual clutter while retaining the joyful children's cut-paper identity. ONE COMPLETE DESKTOP WEBPAGE from navigation to footer in one tall raster image, aspect ratio 1:3, target 1280x3840. Not a mobile layout, not a poster, no browser frame. Show every block, do not crop bottom.
The user likes the warm playful direction but says it is too crowded. THE MAIN CHANGE IS MUCH MORE AIR, not a color change. Aim for approximately 45% quiet undecorated page area, 2x larger section padding and noticeably generous gaps within groups. LESS environmental scenery, fewer decorations, fewer repeated characters, cleaner silhouettes, restrained short shadows, virtually no surface noise. Keep a real children's storybook personality: one confident illustrated scene, large warm friendly titles, a few organic cut-paper boundaries, selected playful food cutouts. Do not turn it into a corporate SaaS template.
Reference roles: image 1 = previous full-page design to substantially simplify, NOT a density template. Image 2 = approved paper background/material. Images 3 and 4 = exact boy and girl character identity and outfits. Image 5 = simple FLAT paper food and props. Keep boy in cream sun T-shirt and green shorts; girl with pale pink bob, daisy hairclip and yellow dress, slightly taller. European picture book, no anime, no toddler proportions. Render foods from few flat matte paper shapes, no photographic crusts, glossy ceramic bowls, moist surfaces, sculpted 3D or clay. Texture sparse and quiet; short contact shadows at paper edges. No dense forest borders framing every section, floating confetti, foliage creeping between every card, repeated speech bubbles, giant utensil decorations or potted plants everywhere.
WIDE-MONITOR CONSTRAINT: depict a centered content column with max-width equivalent to 1440 inside a wider 1920-wide desktop page. Keep useful content about 75% of screenshot width with broad quiet left/right gutters. Section BACKGROUND COLORS continue edge-to-edge across the entire page. Decorative artwork is contained or fades naturally into an even flat sky/paper color. No critical character/food at viewport edges. The composition must remain believable when a larger screen reveals more plain background on the sides; never stretch characters or food to fill width. No technical labels, pixel/rem annotations or devices in the design.
RETAIN ALL CONTENT, do not obtain air by deleting blocks:
Header: small simple plate logo + «Три друга»; «Смотреть», «Играть», «Семейное меню», «Взрослым». No search or social icons.
Hero: «Три друга на тарелке», small «Истории и игры о еде · 8–12 лет», two buttons «Смотреть мультфильм» and «Выбрать игру», one appealing shared scene with our boy and girl around a food plate. Exactly one bubble «Тосту скучно одному!».
Groups: «Кого позовём на тарелку?» with exactly three small-to-medium paper food arrangements, clearly labeled «Овощи и фрукты», «Крупы и хлеб», «Белок». Room around each.
Film: «Смотрим истории». One featured landscape poster «Три друга на тарелке» — «68 секунд», and two compact episode previews «Сад в животе» — «27 секунд», «Ужин: слушай живот» — «26 секунд». Clear play controls, open space between all 3.
Games: «Пробуем сами». Exactly SEVEN entries: «Собери тарелку», «Паровозик и сад», «Ланч-бокс для друга», «Что в блюде?», «Правда или миф», «Что говорит живот?», «Собери перекус». An entry contains ONE small illustrative preview, title and tiny arrow, nothing more. Same calm backgrounds for most entries, no extra numbering or multi-colored badges. Featured entry only subtly emphasized. Tiny caption «Ошибаться можно — герои подскажут».
Menu: «Продолжим дома», «Что приготовить завтра?», three modest neatly separated dish previews titled «Сырники с ягодами», «Плов с курицей», «Рыба с картошкой»; button «Все 45 блюд и заготовки».
Adults: «Родителям и учителям», three lightweight accordion rows «Нужно ли доедать?», «Как говорить о еде?», «На что мы опираемся?» and link «Источники». Compact dark-green footer with brand/nav only.
Main characters outside actual film thumbnails should appear only in the hero, optionally ONE small supporting cameo elsewhere, not surrounding all blocks. Use readable Cyrillic, friendly Balsamiq-like headings and Nunito-like body/UI; short copy only, no lorem ipsum, no medical claims, no tool/AI mentions. Hierarchy and breathing room matter more than adding objects.

DESIGN A — AIRY STORYBOOK. Keep the most successful atmospheric idea from reference 1: a dusk-teal paper outdoor cinema in the film block. Make this the ONLY strongly scenic middle section. Hero: pale clear blue sky, title left and a medium-size child-and-plate scene right; minimal landscape only along the lower edge, no trees framing the entire viewport. Groups: open ivory paper with three food group arrangements and lots of space. Cinema: generous flat deep-teal band; sparse two or three leaf silhouettes at far bottom and one restrained short string of five warm lights maximum; one large main video with two smaller previews, NOT a jungle scene with cushions/lanterns/props. Games: quiet pale sage field, simple roomy layout of 3 top entries and 4 bottom entries; all seven readable, no winding road or cartoon forest behind them. Menu: pale warm peach full-width band with three clean food cards, NO kitchen-room background, huge props or flanking characters. FAQ: plain ivory. Flowing section edges only at hero and cinema. Distinct serene areas with the magic concentrated into a few memorable moments.

name: open-storybook
label: Свободная книжная страница
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. NEW DESIGN, NOT a small tweak. Generate a beautifully art-directed ENTIRE desktop children's food homepage from header to footer in a tall 1:3 image, target 1280x3840. The most important quality is GENEROUS EMPTY SPACE. A previous generated version was rejected for crowding. Make a warm playful picture-book website with adult-quality editorial spacing: very open, intentional and easy to scan.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: the picture represents a 1920px-wide desktop with a centered MAXIMUM 1440px content area. ALL titles, cards, dishes, UI and characters sit inside the CENTRAL 75% OF THE IMAGE WIDTH. The leftmost and rightmost 12.5% of EVERY section are QUIET EMPTY BACKGROUND. No plants, food, people, letters, labels, frames or cards in these side gutters. Broad FLAT BACKGROUND COLORS extend fully to the left and right image edge. This is crucial to illustrate a page that stops growing on big monitors. Do NOT fill those gutters with decorations.
At least HALF of the overall page should be calm unoccupied paper/sky background. Objects and pictures are markedly smaller relative to their sections than standard dense landing-page mockups. Generous top/bottom padding around every heading and content group, very generous card gaps. Fewer details, clearer hierarchy. Natural handmade character without clutter or an empty corporate template.
Input references: 1 paper material and natural world only, NOT a required background to repeat; 2 approved 10yo boy identity (brown hair, cream sun shirt, green shorts, cream shoes); 3 approved slightly taller 11yo girl (pink bob, daisy clip, light-yellow dress, green sandals); 4 FOOD SHAPES in simple flat colored paper. Preserve outfits and faces, use small simple eyes, not anime, not toddler style. Paper is matte flat cutouts with light sparse fibers and short contact shadows. No photographic food, glossy ceramic, clay, realistic crusts, 3D lumps, embossing, all-over noise, or fake paper filter. No generic stock icons as a substitute for illustrated food.
Layout, top to bottom, EVERY section included:
HEADER 3% height: small plate logo and «Три друга», four short links «Смотреть», «Играть», «Семейное меню», «Взрослым». Warm ivory strip, calm.
HERO about 18% height: dominant heading at left «Три друга на тарелке», friendly Balsamiq-like dark-green lettering with a single terracotta word. Small «Истории и игры о еде · 8–12 лет». Two simple buttons «Смотреть мультфильм» and «Выбрать игру». At right, ONE self-contained paper-cut scene of boy and girl assembling a plate; medium scale, not enormous heads. One bubble «Тосту скучно одному!». Background is mainly pale blue and ivory; only one simple distant hill and tiny sun, NO forest border. Characters may appear only here and inside the actual video thumbnails.
GROUPS 12% height: ivory blank breathing space, heading «Кого позовём на тарелку?», three clean small food arrangements below with broad open gaps; titles «Овощи и фрукты», «Крупы и хлеб», «Белок». About 3 flat food cutouts per group, no spilling piles, wrappers or caption badges. No plants or arrows scattered around.
FILMS 17% height: one restrained deep teal full-width background, heading «Смотрим истории», one main landscape thumbnail occupying left 58% of CONTENT COLUMN, with boy/girl and play control, title «Три друга на тарелке», «68 секунд». On right 2 SMALL landscape previews on separate airy rows labeled «Сад в животе» — «27 секунд», «Ужин: слушай живот» — «26 секунд». All frames sit well inside content column. A TINY crescent or short string of 3 lights is enough atmosphere. Absolutely no giant trees, foliage, lanterns, cushions or theatre props around the frames.
GAMES 23% height: broad pale-sage background, lots of breathing space, heading «Пробуем сами», little caption «Ошибаться можно — герои подскажут». SEVEN MODEST cards, 4 on top row and 3 CENTERED on bottom row, clearly separated with large airy gutters. Same ivory card surface, soft subtle corners and short shadow. Each has ONE modest paper object or micro-scene, concise dark-green title and tiny arrow. Titles exactly «Собери тарелку», «Паровозик и сад», «Ланч-бокс для друга», «Что в блюде?», «Правда или миф», «Что говорит живот?», «Собери перекус». Do not draw extra big characters on these cards, no numbering, badges, multiple CTA pills, dotted roads, trailing leaves, dense illustrations or bright individual backgrounds.
MENU 16% height: warm pale apricot, heading «Что приготовить завтра?» with small «Продолжим дома». Three clean small illustrated dishes, evenly spaced on plain paper, names «Сырники с ягодами», «Плов с курицей», «Рыба с картошкой». One CTA below «Все 45 блюд и заготовки». NO kitchen backdrop, no giant book, no scissors/tape/utensil decor, no parents or heroes. Only dishes and text in the spacious centered area.
ADULTS 9% height: ivory, «Родителям и учителям», quiet accordion lines «Нужно ли доедать?», «Как говорить о еде?», «На что мы опираемся?», «Источники» small link. No illustration at all.
FOOTER 2% height: plain forest-green strip, small brand and navigation.
Total design must read as a real usable spacious DESKTOP web page with 2–4 column desktop layouts, NOT a mobile stack, poster, app screenshot mosaic, device mockup or technical diagram. Clean readable Russian. No search/social features, no random extra functions, no pixel/rem labels, no AI/tool mentions. Rhythmic large typography and a FEW expressive illustrations carry the fun; negative space and calm surface carry clarity. Keep ALL CONTENT, scale objects down to fit, do not crop lower sections or squeeze padding.
